command:
cat > /root/ansible/blacklist-usb-storage.yml <<'EOF'
---
- name: Prevent usb-storage kernel module from loading
  hosts: managed
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: Blacklist usb-storage module (persist across reboots)
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf
        content: |
          blacklist usb-storage
          install usb-storage /bin/false
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
      register: blacklist_file

    - name: Update initramfs so the blacklist is honored at boot
      ansible.builtin.command: update-initramfs -u
      when: blacklist_file.changed

    - name: Ensure usb-storage module is not currently loaded
      community.general.modprobe:
        name: usb-storage
        state: absent
EOF
